function: Joint channel estimation and data detection for a massive MIMO uplink receiver; a GNN refines the marginal likelihoods inside BiG-AMP iterations (p. 4, 6, 7).
system: Uplink MIMO: BS with Nr receive antennas, Nt single-antenna users (16x8, 32x8, 32x16), Rayleigh block fading, 16-QAM, T=160; no RIS; no frequency band given (p. 2, 10, 12).
method: Graph neural network (MLP message passing, GRU update, MLP readout) inside BiG-AMP loops; supervised: cross-entropy, MSE, then multitask uncertainty-weighted loss, step-by-step with pre-trained models (p. 5, 6, 9).
data_channel: Own simulation: Rayleigh block fading, 16-QAM, SNR 5-30 dB, 10^5 samples per epoch; Kronecker channel (rho 0.3) also tested; no standard or measured data (p. 10, 11, 13).
test_conditions: Trained on Rayleigh, SNR 5-30 dB, Tp=32; tested over SNR and Tp, and on Kronecker channel after Rayleigh pre-training plus 50 multitask epochs (BiGNN-BiGAMP) (p. 11, 13).
baselines: Classical: iterative LMMSE, BiG-AMP, VB; learned: OAMPNet2 (model-driven deep learning receiver); ablation: GNN-BiGAMP without variance features (p. 10, 12).
metrics: Symbol error rate (SER), NMSE of the channel, pilots needed for a target SER or NMSE, real-valued multiplications (RVMs) (p. 10, 12).
complexity: RVMs: formulas plus Table I last column (Nr=32, Nt=16): BiG-AMP 3.70e6, GNN-BiGAMP 3.72e8, BiGNN-BiGAMP 4.53e8, OAMPNet2 2.69e10 (p. 10, 11).
q1_support: p. 10: "a Rayleigh block fading channel is considered". Custom simulator (Kronecker correlation rho = 0.3 on p. 13); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 11: "to verify the adaptation of the proposed training scheme over different channel states": BiGNN-BiGAMP pre-trained on Rayleigh, tested on Kronecker after 50 extra multitask epochs (also p. 9).
q3_support: p. 10: "Iterative LMMSE: A traditional solution" and "OAMPNet2: A model-driven deep learning MIMO receiver"; p. 11: "significantly outperform the classical iterative LMMSE, BiG-AMP and VB receivers and learning-based OAMPNet2" in SER and NMSE.
q4_support: p. 10: "the computational complexity of different receivers is analyzed in terms of number of real-valued multiplications (RVMs), as presented in Table I" (values on p. 11).
q5_support: p. 10: "All simulations are executed on a desktop with GPU NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090". Data are self-simulated Rayleigh channels; no code or data link or DOI appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: The PDF is the paper of the DOI (p. 1: Digital Object Identifier 10.1109/TWC.2025.3543176). Area is borderline 1 vs 2: JCD with SER and NMSE both main metrics (p. 10); area 1 chosen because the first proposed GNN acts on the data-detection loop, trained with symbol cross-entropy (p. 6), and SER is listed first. Reviewer to confirm. q2 rests on the BiGNN-BiGAMP adaptation to the Kronecker channel (p. 9, 11); the Tp and antenna sweeps do not state whether the model was retrained, so they are not used. Table I values read from the page image (p. 11).
